steps.name: PCG 다리 북서 한계로 정상 이동
steps.wait: new System.Func<bool>(()=>{var p=new UnityEngine.Vector2(PlayableProbe.PartyX,PlayableProbe.PartyY)*.0113f;var d=new UnityEngine.Vector2(-5.1f,5.65f)-p;PlayableProbe.SetMove(d.x,d.y*.5f);return PlayableProbe.Screen=="Battle" && d.magnitude<.15f && UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(p.x)+UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(p.y)>10.5f;})()

steps.name: N 최대 이동 한계까지 일반 입력
steps.wait: new System.Func<bool>(()=>{var p=new UnityEngine.Vector2(PlayableProbe.PartyX,PlayableProbe.PartyY)*.0113f;var d=new UnityEngine.Vector2(0f,12f)-p;PlayableProbe.SetMove(d.x,d.y*.5f);return PlayableProbe.Screen=="Battle" && p.y*1>10.74f && UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(p.x)<.01f;})()

steps.name: N 실제 가장자리 1920×1080
steps.do: PlayableProbe.SetMove(0,0); UnityEngine.Time.timeScale=0; System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory("output/hd2d-3d-part1"); System.IO.File.AppendAllText("output/hd2d-3d-part1/edge-positions.jsonl", Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new { direction="N", x=PlayableProbe.PartyX*.0113f, y=PlayableProbe.PartyY*.0113f, frame=UnityEngine.Time.frameCount, utc=System.DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O")})+"\n");
